correctness.rationale: For commuting \(\mathcal S_4\) operators, quadratic products are Hilbert–Schmidt and quartic products trace class. Expanding the mixed-commutator energy and using trace cyclicity plus pairwise commutativity gives exactly the squared Hilbert–Schmidt norm of the summed self-commutator; the stated rigidity consequences follow. The finite-tracial version uses the identical expansion.
